summary: Iteration 3 testing of SwingEdge Lite. Verified the 3 user-asked changes: (a) NO DEMO_SEED in /api/positions (rows=0, no markers — correct/honest result), (b) watchlist auto-extend via yfinance works for unknown-but-real symbols (CONCORDBIO auto-added to universe.csv) and rejects truly-fake symbols with HTTP 400, (c) /api/universe/summary now returns 3-level breakdown (sectors=12, industries=71, basic_industries=72) and frontend shows SECTOR/INDUSTRY/BASIC toggle. GROWW row in /api/watchlist now has full real data (grade=A+, rs_score=0.205, close=218.02, bucket=Bullish, grade_history_5d=['A-','A+','A+','A+','A+']). However, 3 backend regressions found: /api/screen, /api/rs_grid, and /api/symbol/<auto-added-sym> all return HTTP 500 due to unscrubbed NaN/Inf floats — same root cause as iteration-2 watchlist NaN bug, but the fix wasn't applied to these other endpoints. 22/26 pytest tests pass (4 expose real bugs).

critical.issue: HTTP 500 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant' — `df.where(pd.notnull(df), None)` does not actually replace NaN floats in mixed-dtype dataframes; GROWW row has NaN sma200 that crashes JSON serialization. Apply same astype(object).where() + per-row NaN/Inf scrub used in /api/watchlist (iteration 2 fix).
HTTP 500 — same NaN-in-screen_today.csv root cause; _safe_float covers most fields but raw NaN can still leak through r.get('grade') or other unprotected reads when df.where() fails.

HTTP 500 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant'. Reproducer: POST /api/watchlist/add {symbol:CONCORDBIO} → wait 12s → GET /api/symbol/CONCORDBIO → 500. RCA: the on-the-fly indicators.compute_indicators_for_symbol invocation in watchlist_add._backfill_one produces +/-Inf in some indicator columns (likely division by zero on short-history bars). symbol_detail at line 535 only does `df.where(pd.notnull(df), None)` which handles NaN but NOT Inf, and there is no per-bar `np.isinf` scrub before to_dict(). Need to coerce both NaN and Inf to None.

minor.issue: Returns {available, rows, summary} but omits `stats` key — populated branch returns {rows, summary, stats}. Inconsistent shape; frontend has to defensively check. Add `stats: {}` to the empty-table return at line 297.

Same NaN-in-merged-dataframe risk if any current_price from screen_today.csv is NaN; fine today because GROWW isn't in positions yet, but will reproduce once positions are seeded for symbols with NaN sma.

ui_bugs.issue: Buttons not exposed via accessible role 'button' — Playwright get_by_role('button', name='SECTOR') returns 0. They render as styled <span>/<div> with click handlers. Visually present and click-able by coordinates. Add role='button' or use real <button> element for a11y + testability.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /api/rs_grid returns 500, but frontend shows 'RS GRID [399]' — likely operating on cached-from-earlier-success state; new sessions will see empty/error. Triggered by GROWW NaN.

action_items: Apply iteration-2 NaN-scrub pattern (df.astype(object).where(pd.notnull(df), None) + per-row {NaN,Inf}->None) to /api/screen, /api/rs_grid, and /api/symbol/{symbol}. Also extend the per-row scrub to handle math.inf (np.isinf), not just NaN, since auto-extend backfill can produce Inf indicators on short-history symbols.
Fix /api/positions empty-branch return at server.py:297 to include `stats: {}` key for shape consistency.
Make UniverseSummary SECTOR/INDUSTRY/BASIC toggle real <button> elements (or add role='button' + aria-label) so they're keyboard-accessible and Playwright-testable.

Investigate why indicators.compute_indicators_for_symbol produces Inf for newly-auto-added symbols (likely zero ATR or zero volume causing division). Either guard the math or replace Inf with NaN before upsert.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:get_screen line 210 — `df.where(pd.notnull(df), None)` is unreliable for replacing NaN in mixed-dtype frames; same bug pattern as iteration-2 watchlist. Use df.astype(object).where(...) + explicit per-row scrub.
server.py:symbol_detail line 535 — same issue as get_screen, plus no Inf handling. Add: `for k,v in r.items(): if isinstance(v,float) and (v!=v or math.isinf(v)): r[k]=None`
server.py:get_positions line 297 — empty-branch return omits `stats` key; populated branch returns it. Shape inconsistency.

server.py:watchlist_add._backfill_one — runs heavy yfinance fetch + indicator compute synchronously inside a daemon thread without timeout/retry/error-surfacing; if it crashes, user sees no feedback. Consider exposing per-symbol backfill status via /api/pipeline/status.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: After iteration-3, GROWW (a recent IPO with <200 trading days) has NaN sma200 in /app/output/screen_today.csv. The endpoints /api/screen (line 210) and /api/rs_grid (line 223) use `df.where(pd.notnull(df), None)` to scrub NaN, but pandas re-promotes the float column dtype after .where() so NaN re-appears in to_dict() output, causing FastAPI's json.dumps to throw 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant'. Iteration 2 fixed exactly this for /api/watchlist using `df.astype(object).where(pd.notnull(df), None)` + an explicit per-row NaN coercion loop, but the fix wasn't backported to screen/rs_grid/symbol_detail. Symbol_detail has an additional Inf source: watchlist_add._backfill_one runs indicators.compute_indicators_for_symbol on a freshly fetched short-history yfinance series, which produces +/-Inf in derived columns (likely zero-divide in volume-normalized indicators). The current scrub doesn't check np.isinf, only NaN. REPRODUCTION: curl /api/screen → 500. curl /api/rs_grid → 500. POST /api/watchlist/add {symbol:CONCORDBIO} → wait 12s → curl /api/symbol/CONCORDBIO → 500. MITIGATION: in each impacted endpoint, replace `df.where(pd.notnull(df), None)` with `df = df.astype(object).where(pd.notnull(df), None)` then loop rows: `for k,v in r.items(): if isinstance(v,float) and (math.isnan(v) or math.isinf(v)): r[k]=None`.
